decisions.quote: Our results corroborate MLLC's finding that lone-founder firms outperform other types of firms.
decisions.reason: The abstract explicitly concludes that the results corroborate MLLC's finding that lone-founder firms outperform other types of firms. The additional finding on family ownership levels cited in the shipped quote reports a contextual nuance without stating what MLLC found on that point or framing it as a contrast with the original study.
